afterClose.zh-CN: 弹层完全关闭后调用，两种模式都会调用。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the panel has fully closed, in both modes.

afterVisibleChange.zh-CN: 显示状态变化且动画结束后调用，仅 popup 模式调用。
afterVisibleChange.en-US: Called once the shown state has changed and the animation has ended. Only popup mode calls it.

cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性。loading 取内置的挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真；onclick 先于内置处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button. It is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so. onclick runs before the built-in handling, which still runs.

bodyStyle.zh-CN: 内容区的样式字符串，两种模式通用。
bodyStyle.en-US: Style string of the body, for both modes.

canVerticalSetWidth.zh-CN: 仅 popup 模式：placement 为 top、bottom 时 width 是否生效；默认这两种位置横向铺满。
canVerticalSetWidth.en-US: Popup mode only: whether width applies when placement is top or bottom. By default those sheets span the full width.

cancelLoading.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：取消按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 onCancel 返回的 Promise，显式传入 false 关闭该行为。
cancelLoading.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the cancel button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by onCancel; pass false to turn that off.

cancelText.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：取消按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Modal.cancel。
cancelText.en-US: Modal mode only: cancel button text. Defaults to the locale entry Modal.cancel.

centered.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：是否垂直居中显示。
centered.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the dialog is vertically centered.

closable.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮。
closable.en-US: Whether the close button in the corner is shown.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 是否允许按 Esc 取消。

confirmLoading.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：确认按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 onOk 返回的 Promise，显式传入 false 关闭该行为。
confirmLoading.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the ok button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by onOk; pass false to turn that off.

disableScroll.zh-CN: 仅 popup 模式：带遮罩且渲染在 document.body 中时是否禁止 body 滚动。
disableScroll.en-US: Popup mode only: whether body scrolling is locked while a masked sheet is rendered in document.body.

footerFill.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：默认页脚的两个按钮是否撑满排列。
footerFill.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the two buttons of the default footer fill the row.

fullScreen.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：是否全屏显示，开启后 width、height 不再生效。
fullScreen.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the dialog fills the screen. width and height are ignored.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定弹层渲染到的父级 DOM。自定义容器需要设置 position: relative。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent element the layer is rendered into. A custom container needs position: relative.

hasCancel.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：默认页脚是否显示取消按钮。
hasCancel.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the default footer shows the cancel button.

headerStyle.zh-CN: 仅 popup 模式：面板头部的样式字符串。
headerStyle.en-US: Popup mode only: style string of the panel header.

height.zh-CN: 高度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度；popup 模式仅 placement 为 top、bottom 时生效。
height.en-US: Height. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. In popup mode it applies only when placement is top or bottom.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留内部节点而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the content stays mounted while closed.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：配合 keepDOM 使用；为 true 时，首次显示之前不渲染对话框。
lazyRender.en-US: Modal mode only: used with keepDOM. When true, the dialog is not rendered until it is first shown.

mask.zh-CN: 是否显示遮罩；popup 模式默认没有遮罩，页面其余部分保持可用。
mask.en-US: Whether the mask is shown; in popup mode there is no mask by default and the rest of the page stays usable.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 是否允许点击遮罩取消。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether a click on the mask cancels the feedback.

maskFixed.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：遮罩限定在自定义容器内时，是否仍以 fixed 定位覆盖整个视口并按模态处理。
maskFixed.en-US: Modal mode only: whether a mask confined to a custom container still covers the viewport with fixed positioning and is treated as modal.

modalContentClass.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：对话框内容元素的类名。
modalContentClass.en-US: Modal mode only: class name of the dialog content element.

motion.en-US: Whether the enter and leave animations run.

okText.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：确认按钮文字，缺省取语言包 Modal.confirm。
okText.en-US: Modal mode only: ok button text. Defaults to the locale entry Modal.confirm.

okType.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：确认按钮的类型。
okType.en-US: Modal mode only: type of the ok button.

placement.zh-CN: 仅 popup 模式：面板滑出的位置。
placement.en-US: Popup mode only: edge the sheet slides in from.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：组件内部调用 focus 时是否阻止浏览器滚动到被聚焦元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Modal mode only: whether the focus calls made by the component avoid scrolling the focused element into view.

role.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：对话框的 role，可选 dialog 或 alertdialog。
role.en-US: Modal mode only: role of the dialog, dialog or alertdialog.

size.zh-CN: 宽度档位：small 为 448px，medium 为 684px，large 为 920px；popup 模式仅 placement 为 left、right 时生效。
size.en-US: Width preset: small is 448px, medium 684px, large 920px. In popup mode it applies only when placement is left or right.

style.zh-CN: 样式字符串；落点见下方说明。
style.en-US: Style string; see the note below for where it lands.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度；不传时由 size 决定。
width.en-US: Width. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. When omitted, size decides.

checkboxExtra.zh-CN: 自定义 checkboxGroupProps.options 中每一项辅助文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
checkboxExtra.en-US: Snippet for the extra text of each item in checkboxGroupProps.options, with `{ option, index }` as its argument.

checkboxGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 checkbox 时多选组的属性，写法同 CheckboxGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
checkboxGroupProps.en-US: Props of the checkbox group for the checkbox type, written as the props of CheckboxGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

checkboxLabel.zh-CN: 自定义 checkboxGroupProps.options 中每一项文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
checkboxLabel.en-US: Snippet for the label of each item in checkboxGroupProps.options, with `{ option, index }` as its argument.

children.zh-CN: type 为 custom 时的反馈内容。

content.zh-CN: 包裹或替换内置内容的 snippet，任何 type 都可用，参数 `{ content }` 是内置内容，用 `{@render content()}` 放置。
content.en-US: Snippet that wraps or replaces the built-in content for any type. Its argument `{ content }` is the built-in content; place it with `{@render content()}`.

footer.zh-CN: 替换默认的取消、提交按钮；传入 `null` 时不渲染页脚区域。
footer.en-US: Replaces the default cancel and submit buttons; `null` renders no footer area.

header.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：完全替换默认头部，传入 `null` 时不渲染头部。
header.en-US: Modal mode only: replaces the whole default header; `null` renders no header.

icon.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：标题前的图标。
icon.en-US: Modal mode only: icon before the title.

modal.zh-CN: 仅 modal 模式：自定义渲染对话框本身，参数 `{ modal }` 是 `role="dialog"` 元素，用 `{@render modal()}` 放置。
modal.en-US: Modal mode only: custom rendering of the dialog itself. Its argument `{ modal }` is the `role="dialog"` element; place it with `{@render modal()}`.

mode.zh-CN: 展示模式：popup 是底部无遮罩的非模态面板（SideSheet），modal 是模态对话框（Modal）。未声明的属性按模式落到对应的 SideSheet 或 Modal 上。
mode.en-US: Display mode: popup is a non-modal panel at the bottom without a mask (SideSheet); modal is a modal dialog (Modal). Attributes Feedback does not declare go to the SideSheet or Modal of the current mode.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 提交按钮的属性。未给 disabled 时按值禁用（值为空时禁用），给出后以使用方的值为准，type 为 custom 时用它控制提交；loading 取内置的挂起态与使用方的 loading 任一为真；onclick 先于内置处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the submit button. Without disabled, it is disabled while the value is empty; a disabled you give wins, which is how the custom type controls submission. It is loading when either the built-in pending state or your loading says so. onclick runs before the built-in handling, which still runs.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消按钮、关闭按钮、Esc（modal 模式另有点击遮罩）触发；按 Esc 时参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。返回后清空已填写的值并把 visible 写回 false；返回 Promise 时取消按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空并写回，reject 时保持打开。
onCancel.en-US: Called by the cancel button, the close button, Esc and, in modal mode, a click on the mask; the argument is a native KeyboardEvent for Esc. Once it returns, the filled-in value is cleared and visible is written back as false. A returned Promise keeps the cancel button loading; both happen only once it fulfills, and a rejection keeps the feedback open.

onOk.zh-CN: 点击提交按钮时调用，返回后清空已填写的值；返回 Promise 时按钮保持加载，fulfill 后才清空，reject 时保留。组件不会自行关闭，由使用方把 visible 设为 false。
onOk.en-US: Called when the submit button is clicked; the filled-in value is cleared once it returns. A returned Promise keeps the button loading and the value is cleared only once it fulfills, and kept when it rejects. The component never closes itself on submit; the caller sets visible to false.

onValueChange.zh-CN: 反馈内容变化时调用，参数为当前值：text 为字符串，emoji 为 `{ emoji, text }`（text 是选了「差」后填写的原因），radio 为所选项的值，checkbox 为所选值的数组。
onValueChange.en-US: Called when the feedback content changes, with the current value: a string for text, `{ emoji, text }` for emoji (text is the reason filled in after choosing the bad face), the value of the chosen option for radio, and an array of chosen values for checkbox.

radioExtra.zh-CN: 自定义 radioGroupProps.options 中每一项辅助文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
radioExtra.en-US: Snippet for the extra text of each item in radioGroupProps.options, with `{ option, index }` as its argument.

radioGroupProps.zh-CN: type 为 radio 时单选组的属性，写法同 RadioGroup 的属性。选项组默认没有可访问名称，请用 aria-label 命名。
radioGroupProps.en-US: Props of the radio group for the radio type, written as the props of RadioGroup. The group has no accessible name by default; name it with aria-label.

radioLabel.zh-CN: 自定义 radioGroupProps.options 中每一项文本的 snippet，参数为 `{ option, index }`。
radioLabel.en-US: Snippet for the label of each item in radioGroupProps.options, with `{ option, index }` as its argument.

textAreaProps.zh-CN: type 为 text 与 emoji 时多行输入框的属性；其中的 onChange 照常调用，不会替换内置处理。
textAreaProps.en-US: Props of the multi-line input for the text and emoji types; its onChange is called as usual and does not replace the built-in handling.

title.zh-CN: 标题，可以是字符串或 snippet，同时作为对话框的可访问名称。
title.en-US: Title, a string or a snippet, which also names the dialog.

type.zh-CN: 反馈内容的类型。custom 时内容写在子节点中。
type.en-US: Type of the feedback content. For custom, the content goes in the children.

visible.zh-CN: 是否显示，可用 `bind:visible` 双向绑定；取消路径（取消按钮、关闭按钮、Esc，modal 模式另有遮罩）会把它写回 `false`，提交按钮不会关闭。
visible.en-US: Whether the feedback is shown; bind it with `bind:visible`. A cancel path (cancel button, close button, Esc, and the mask in modal mode) writes `false` back; the submit button never closes it.

getRoot.zh-CN: Portal 内 Modal 或 SideSheet 的最外层元素，未渲染时为 null。
getRoot.en-US: The outermost element of the Modal or SideSheet inside the portal, or null while nothing is rendered.
